working_title: Evaluator Sensitivity in Scientific Error Localization: A Reproducibility Audit of FLAWS
research_object: The 115 error instances and 575 released identification-model outputs in the pinned public non-ML CS extension of FLAWS.

research_questions.question: Do released lexical decisions reproduce under the pinned implementation and the metric described in the paper?
How much do cell decisions and model rankings change when unchanged context is removed from modified-text ground truth while all separately localized error excerpts are retained?
How stable are cell decisions and adjusted model rankings when the insertion-model judge is replaced by two blinded open-weight judge lineages?
How sensitive are conclusions to a liberal OR rule, component-wise decisions, and a three-component majority rule?

claim_ceiling.maximum: Benchmark-specific evaluator sensitivity and reproducibility findings for the pinned public non-ML FLAWS extension.
forbidden: Claiming that any evaluator is more valid without independent human labels on the 115-instance extension.
Claiming generic LLM-judge bias, self-preference, or generator-evaluator contamination from disagreement alone.
Generalizing rankings or effect sizes to the 713-instance main FLAWS benchmark.
Describing local open-weight judgments as human annotation.

ground_truth_sets.definition: All modified_text chunks plus every official location_error excerpt, normalized and deduplicated.
Sentences in modified_text that are absent from the paired original_text, plus every official location_error excerpt, normalized and deduplicated.
ground_truth_sets.invariant: No official location_error excerpt may be dropped merely because it was not directly edited.

deterministic_evaluator_conditions.definition: Released score files parsed at each cumulative k.
Exact behavioral replay of the pinned evaluation implementation, including its observed suffix enumeration, final-row maximum, non-strict threshold, and empty-output behavior.
Symmetric all-contiguous-sentence-span normalized word Levenshtein similarity with a strict greater-than 0.5 threshold.
The paper-specified lexical metric applied to focal_truth.

independent_judge_contract.task: For every candidate excerpt, decide only whether it is the same paper excerpt as at least one reference excerpt, allowing subset, superset, LaTeX, whitespace, and plain-text formatting differences. Scientific correctness and semantic plausibility are out of scope.
independent_judge_contract.batching: One error instance per request, with five anonymized candidate lists and at most ten excerpts per list.
independent_judge_contract.adjudication: Use candidate-level majority. Run a third identical-format judgment only for candidate verdicts that disagree across the first two repeats.
independent_judge_contract.malformed_output_policy: One format-only retry is allowed. A second malformed output is missing, never positive. Confirmatory analysis is blocked until every expected cell has a valid final verdict.
independent_judge_contract.provider_isolation: No web browsing, repository context, prior conversation, private memory, or model/inserter identity is supplied to the judge.

primary_conditions.definition: At least two positives among paper_specified_focal_lexical, final judge_lineage_qwen, and final judge_lineage_mistral

cell_level: paired top-10 decision flip rate relative to published_combined
directional top-10 rate difference relative to published_combined
model_level: insertion-family-adjusted identification coefficient at each k
mean adjusted identification coefficient over k=1..10

adjusted_ranking_model.exclusion: Exclude cells where the identification model is the same released model as the insertion model.
adjusted_ranking_model.convergence_policy: Report non-convergence or separation; do not silently replace the estimator or condition.

uncertainty.sampling: Sample the 68 unique paper IDs with replacement and retain every associated insertion instance and identification-model cell with cluster multiplicity.

confirmatory_hypotheses.statement: Each independent judge replacement changes at least 5 percent of top-10 cell decisions relative to published_combined.
The two independent judge replacements share at least one pairwise model-order reversal relative to published_combined.
At least one primary independent condition changes either the top-1 model or Kendall tau-b below 0.9 relative to published_combined.

workshop_candidate_if: The pinned code and paper specification yield a mechanically verified decision discrepancy affecting at least 5 percent of cells and at least one model-order reversal; or
Both independent judge replacements share a model-order reversal and at least one primary independent condition changes the top-1 model or has Kendall tau-b below 0.9.
downgrade_if: All primary conditions preserve the same top-1 model.
Every primary independent condition has Kendall tau-b at least 0.9.
Each primary independent condition changes at most 5 percent of top-10 cell decisions.
No common pairwise order reversal appears across the two judge lineages.
paper_worthiness_gate.downgrade_genre: benchmark reproducibility note or negative measurement report
paper_worthiness_gate.next_action_after_downgrade: Return to the governed topic portfolio instead of polishing a paper-scale claim.

reporting_requirements: Separate exploratory findings known before protocol freeze from confirmatory independent-judge findings.
Report all frozen primary and secondary conditions, including null and contradictory results.
Report counts as well as percentages.
Report cluster-aware uncertainty and the 68-paper effective cluster count.
Publish the exact prompts, model digests, generation options, raw structured verdicts, retries, timeouts, and content hashes.
Keep model names in scientific result artifacts but never hardcode them into reusable AutoLabOS runtime contracts or public-code fixtures.
